reviews.text: Interesting and informative chat with Marco
Without a doubt, wherever I have found hospitality and professionalism, the dog's well-being is the primary objective.

We adopted a setter from a shelter full of fears, probably because he was deprived as a puppy.
The owner, Marco De Paola, and his staff (Gianni and Simone) have changed the way we interact with our furry friend.
In a short time, we learned how to behave and how to interact with the leash (which was changed thanks to them).

By applying their advice, the relationship is changing, and our furry friend is much calmer on walks.

So, thank you to Marco and his fantastic staff.

PS. They also hold courses for dog trainers.
Great experience and expertise... De Paola is exceptional.
Trained staff, great empathy with dogs and very professional and courteous.
Competence and professionalism on the part of all operators. Recommended.

I found Marco, his team, and especially Silvia, who supported my furry friend throughout this journey, to be incredibly professional and knowledgeable, combined with compassion and empathy. I resolved a serious problem in just one session, but I chose to do the entire program with them to establish a healthy, trusting relationship with my exuberant pup.
I recommend them not only to those with behavioral issues, but to anyone who wants to gain a deeper understanding of their furry friend's mind and establish a happy relationship!
Thank you, Marco, and thank you, Silvia!

I've been there years ago...and I've returned with another dog...the staff is knowledgeable, professional, and friendly. The owner also takes care of the dog training and education first...I highly recommend it...
